methods.comment:
* Finds the {@link ComponentName} of the AccessibilityMenu accessibility service that the * device should be migrated off. Devices using this service should be migrated to * {@link #ACCESSIBILITY_MENU_IN_SYSTEM}. * *

* Requirements: *

  • There are exactly two installed accessibility service components with class name * {@link #MENU_SERVICE_RELATIVE_CLASS_NAME}.
    • *
  • Exactly one of these components is equal to {@link #ACCESSIBILITY_MENU_IN_SYSTEM}.
    • *

    * * @return The {@link ComponentName} of the service that is not {@link * #ACCESSIBILITY_MENU_IN_SYSTEM}, * or null if the above requirements are not met.
